; Split-horizon (internal) view of example.com: most addresses are RFC 1918 space.

@         IN NS   ns1.example.com.

db        IN A    10.0.12.34
git       IN A    10.0.12.35
wiki      IN A    172.16.5.10
ldap      IN A    192.168.10.20
printer   IN A    192.168.10.30
intranet  IN CNAME wiki.example.com.
